passages.sermon:
This is a song for those who go up to worship.
People sing this song as they travel to Jerusalem.
They use this song to praise God.
They remember God as they go to His house.

passages.text: I lift up my eyes to You, the One enthroned in heaven.
passages.sermon: This is a song of ascents.\r\nI lift up my eyes to You.\r\nYou sit enthroned in heaven.
passages.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אֵ֭לֶיךָ נָשָׂ֣אתִי אֶת־ עֵינַ֑י הַ֝יֹּשְׁבִ֗י בַּשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

passages.text: As the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maidservant look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes are on the LORD our God until He shows us mercy.
passages.sermon:
This is a song of ascents by David.
Servants look to the hand of their master.
A maidservant looks to the hand of her mistress.
In the same way, we look to the LORD our God.
We keep looking to Him until He shows us mercy.
passages.original: הִנֵּ֨ה כְעֵינֵ֪י עֲבָדִ֡ים אֶל־ יַ֤ד אֲ‍ֽדוֹנֵיהֶ֗ם כְּעֵינֵ֣י שִׁפְחָה֮ אֶל־ יַ֪ד גְּבִ֫רְתָּ֥הּ כֵּ֣ן עֵ֭ינֵינוּ אֶל־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ עַ֝֗ד שֶׁיְּחָנֵּֽנוּ׃

passages.text: Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy, for we have endured much contempt.
passages.sermon:
The people speak to the LORD.
They ask the LORD for mercy.
They say, "Have mercy on us, LORD."
They repeat, "Have mercy on us."
They explain why they ask.
They say, "We have suffered much contempt."
They have received much scorn from others.
passages.original: חָנֵּ֣נוּ יְהוָ֣ה חָנֵּ֑נוּ כִּֽי־ רַ֝֗ב שָׂבַ֥עְנוּ בֽוּז׃

passages.text: We have endured much scorn from the arrogant, much contempt from the proud.
passages.sermon: Our soul has endured much scorn.\r\nThe arrogant have mocked us.\r\nThe proud have shown us much contempt.
passages.original: רַבַּת֮ שָֽׂבְעָה־ לָּ֪הּ נַ֫פְשֵׁ֥נוּ הַלַּ֥עַג הַשַּׁאֲנַנִּ֑ים הַ֝בּ֗וּז לִגְאֵ֥יוֹנִֽים׃
